09. Frequently asked questions

Questions? Answered.

What is BOUNCER?

BOUNCER is a security services and event staffing platform that connects clients with security personnel and enables event organizers to publish staffing opportunities.

Can I hire bouncers for a wedding?

Yes. You can submit your wedding date, location, event details and required number of personnel through our enquiry form.

Can I hire security for a nightclub or private party?

Yes. You can submit your requirements for clubs, lounges, private parties and other events.

How can I register as a bouncer?

Visit our registration page, complete your professional profile and submit the required details and documents.

Can event organizers post staffing requirements?

Yes. Registered organizers can submit event details and staffing requirements for review and publication.

Are all registered bouncers verified?

Verification depends on the completion of the applicable identity, document and experience checks. Verification status should be displayed accurately on each profile.

Where does BOUNCER operate?

BOUNCER is initially focused on Pune, Maharashtra, with the potential to expand to other locations.

About us

SS Bouncer’s is a security services and event staffing platform based in Pune, Maharashtra. We connect event organizers, businesses and individuals with professional bouncers and security personnel. Every event has unique security needs, from intimate private parties to large public gatherings, and the right team helps maintain order, manage crowds and keep everyone safe. We also create opportunities for bouncers and security professionals to find event assignments, connect with organizers and build their experience.

Our mission

To make professional security services accessible, reliable and convenient while creating meaningful employment opportunities for security professionals.

Our vision

To build a trusted security and event staffing network connecting clients and qualified security personnel across India.

Professionalism

Maintaining discipline and responsible conduct.

Reliability

Prioritizing dependable service and coordination.

Safety

Supporting safer environments through appropriate security arrangements.

Transparency

Clear communication about requirements, pricing and assignments.

Opportunity

Connecting security professionals with suitable work opportunities.

Our commitment

Good security is not just physical presence. It is awareness, discipline, communication, preparedness and responsible behaviour.

Frequently asked questions

How can I hire bouncers through SS Bouncer’s?

Visit the Hire Bouncers page, complete the booking enquiry form, provide your event requirements and wait for the team to contact you.

Can I hire bouncers for a one-day event?

Yes. You can submit requirements for one-day events as well as longer assignments, subject to availability.

Can I post my event?

Yes. Event organizers can submit event details through the Post an Event page. Listings are subject to review and approval.

How can I register as a bouncer?

Visit the Join as Bouncer page, complete your professional profile and submit the required information. Documents are requested after we contact you.

Are there part-time bouncer jobs?

The platform can list part-time and event-based assignments whenever organizers publish such opportunities.

Do you guarantee employment?

No. Registration gives access to listed opportunities but does not guarantee selection, employment or a particular income.

Which areas do you cover?

We are initially focused on Pune and nearby areas. Additional locations can be added as service coverage expands.

How is the booking price calculated?

Pricing depends on the number of personnel, duty hours, event location, event type and specific requirements.
